- Dark brownish discoloration at the base/tip of the split pod

- **Anthracnose**: References showed dark stem/branch lesions — not matching the pod-split presentation

- **Charcoal_Rot**: Field-level yellowing/wilting — not matching
- **Purple_Seed_Stain**: Seeds have purple staining — test image seeds are cream-colored, ruling this out

The split pod with dark tip discoloration and visible seeds most closely matches the Phomopsis pod-splitting presentation, even though the seeds in the test image are less shriveled than some Phomopsis references.
